name: beholder
description: Beholder, an agent kit for Cloudflare apps: Mastra agent worker, gateway and React chat UI, plus a ready-to-copy template.

scripts.check: npm run build && npm run check -w template/agent -w template/web -w demo
scripts.dev: npm run build && npm run dev -w template/web
scripts.demo: npm run build && npm run dev -w demo
scripts.deploy: npm run build && npm run deploy -w template/agent && npm run deploy -w template/web
